specs.name: hill-path
specs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production background for a pixel-art JRPG dialogue stage. Landscape 1536x1024, 3:2. Match the reference's pixel grain, warm earthy palette, dark outlines and slightly elevated close scene perspective. Characters will occupy the LOWER CENTER 60% at roughly one quarter image height; keep this broad foreground playable and uncluttered, put large scenery in upper half and edges. A familiar small pale stone tower with a very faint purple window stands far above the trees. Near foreground a broad level dirt roadside where two travelers can talk. No cart.

specs.name: chapter-props
specs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Transparent pixel-art game item atlas, exactly 3 columns x 2 rows, six separate objects centered within equal square cells. Matching reference pixel style, chunky pixels and dark outlines, front-three-quarter view. Top row: (1) a SMALL shallow wooden dish filled with fernlike green moss, no emitted light, (2) a hand-held brass oil lantern with an orange flame and loop handle, (3) an EMPTY shallow woven wicker work basket. Bottom row: (4) neatly bundled coiled rope, small hand saw and wooden spatula work tools, (5) an unfolded beige parchment sketch map with simple dark route strokes and no text, (6) folded cream-colored thick cloth. Full objects, generous transparent margins in every cell. No characters, no ground, no shadows, no decorative background, no labels, truly transparent alpha.

specs.name: tower-npcs
specs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Transparent pixel-art JRPG NPC sprite sheet, exactly 4 columns by 2 rows. All full bodies, identical chibi 2.5-head-tall scale to reference, centered in equal square cells, ground line identical, generous transparent padding, no grid or text. TOP ROW: ONE elderly tower caretaker with short gray hair and short beard, simple faded blue work coat, brown pants and boots, no hat. Four poses in order: listening calmly; talking open palm; pointing down; farewell raised hand. BOTTOM ROW: ONE adult local drainage worker with tied-back brown hair, ochre work tunic, dark trousers, leather apron and boots, no helmet. Same four poses in order. Face slightly toward viewer's left. Do not copy merchant identity. No handheld tools, no scenery, no floor, no shadows. Match reference chunky pixels and proportions. Transparent alpha background.
